TABLE.NAME: local_mxaimanager_providers
TABLE.COMMENT: Table for storing AI provider information

FIELD.NAME: id
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the record

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Name of the AI provider

FIELD.NAME: classname
FIELD.COMMENT: Class name for the provider implementation

FIELD.NAME: config_json
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON configuration for the provider

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp when the provider was created

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp when the provider was last updated

TABLE.NAME: local_mxaimanager_default_providers
TABLE.COMMENT: Table for storing default providers for each action

FIELD.NAME: id
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the record

FIELD.NAME: action_interface
FIELD.COMMENT: Class name for the action interface

FIELD.NAME: provider_id
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the provider

FIELD.NAME: id
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the record

FIELD.NAME: component
FIELD.COMMENT: Component name of the plugin implementing this feature

FIELD.NAME: name_identifier
FIELD.COMMENT: Language string identifier for the feature name

FIELD.NAME: description_identifier
FIELD.COMMENT: Language string identifier for the feature description

TABLE.NAME: local_mxaimanager_feature_actions
TABLE.COMMENT: Table for storing the actions for each feature, along with optional feature-specific provider and settings overrides

FIELD.NAME: id
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the record

FIELD.NAME: feature_id
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the feature

FIELD.NAME: action_interface
FIELD.COMMENT: Class name for the action interface

FIELD.NAME: provider_id
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the provider (optional override)

FIELD.NAME: settings_json
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON settings for the feature-action combination (optional override)

TABLE.NAME: local_mxaimanager_feature_action_usage_logs
TABLE.COMMENT: Table for logging usage of AI feature actions, including requests, responses, token input/output, timestamps and session ids

FIELD.NAME: id
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the record

FIELD.NAME: feature_id
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the feature

FIELD.NAME: provider_id
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the AI provider used

FIELD.NAME: request_json
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON request sent to the AI provider

FIELD.NAME: response_json
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON response received from the AI provider

FIELD.NAME: input_tokens
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of input tokens used

FIELD.NAME: output_tokens
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of output tokens generated

FIELD.NAME: credits_used
FIELD.COMMENT: Credits consumed by this request

FIELD.NAME: session_id
FIELD.COMMENT: Session identifier for grouping related requests

FIELD.NAME: user_id
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the user making the request

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp when the log entry was created

TABLE.NAME: local_mxaimanager_credit_ledger
TABLE.COMMENT: Credit wallet ledger for tracking purchases and recharges

FIELD.NAME: id
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the record

FIELD.NAME: amount
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of credits added

FIELD.NAME: type
FIELD.COMMENT: Type: initial, recharge, adjustment

FIELD.NAME: note
FIELD.COMMENT: Free-text note (e.g. invoice reference)

FIELD.NAME: created_by
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the admin who performed the recharge

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp when the entry was created

FIELD.NAME: expires_at
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional expiry timestamp for these credits

FIELD.NAME: active
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether this allocation is active (1) or disabled (0)
